body.citation: Baer, Benjamin R., Robert L. Strawderman, and Ashkan Ertefaie. 2023. Causal inference for the expected number of recurrent events in the presence of a terminal event. arXiv:2306.16571. Source: \url{https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.16571}. Proposition 1 and Corollary 1 distinguish full and sequential coarsening at random and state the factual-arm identification specialization; Sections 4.1--4.3 develop efficiency and multiply robust estimation.
